items.source: Set the ClassFilter to use for this pointcut. Default is ClassFilter.TRUE.
items.translation: 设置用于此切点的ClassFilter。默认值为ClassFilter.TRUE。

items.source: Convenience method when we have only a single method name to match. Use either this method or setMappedNames, not both.
items.translation: 当仅需匹配单个方法名时的便捷方法。请使用此方法或`setMappedNames`，但不可同时使用两者。

items.source: Get the Pointcut that drives this advisor.
items.translation: 获取驱动该 Advisor 的切面。

items.source:
Set the method names defining methods to match.
Matching will be the union of all these; if any match,
the pointcut matches.
items.translation: 将定义方法的名称设置为匹配。匹配将是所有这些的并集；如果任何一项匹配，则切入点匹配。

items.source:
Add another eligible method name, in addition to those already named.
Like the set methods, this method is for use when configuring proxies,
before a proxy is used.
items.translation:
添加另一个符合条件的类方法名称，除了已命名的那些之外。
与 `set` 方法类似，此方法用于在代理被使用之前配置代理时。

items.source: name - the name of the additional method that will match
items.translation: name - 将匹配此附加方法的名称

items.source: this pointcut to allow for multiple additions in one line
items.translation: 该切入点允许在一行中进行多次添加。

items.source: Set the ClassFilter to use for this pointcut.
items.translation: 设置用于此切点的ClassFilter。

items.source:
Convenient class for name-match method pointcuts that hold an Advice,
making them an Advisor.
items.translation: 用于名称匹配方法切面的便捷类，它持有 Advice 并将其转换为 Advisor。

items.source: Add another eligible method name, in addition to those already named.
items.translation: 添加另一个符合条件的名称，除了已命名的那些之外。

items.source: Convenience method when we have only a single method name to match.
items.translation: 当只需匹配单个方法名时的便捷方法。

items.source: Set the method names defining methods to match.
items.translation: 将定义方法的名称设置为匹配。
